content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following educational qualifications and age criteria to be eligible for the Legal Researcher position. Educational Qualification: A candidate must be a fresh law graduate or post graduate in law from a University/College/Institution established by law in India. Candidates appearing for the final semester may also apply, but they must submit their final pass out result before the final process of selection including scrutiny or interview. Additional Requirements: Must have research aptitude with good knowledge of research tools, and working knowledge of computer with typing skills. Age Limit: Maximum age of the candidate as on 1st January of year 2027 must not be more than 33 years. Nationality: Candidate must be a citizen of India. Character Requirement: Candidate must be a person of integrity, honesty, and good moral character, certified by two responsible persons who are not in blood relations.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Legal Researchers receive a fixed honorarium of Rs. 50,000/- per month without any dearness or other allowance/perquisite. The engagement is for a term up to 2 years, with initial engagement made for six months subject to satisfactory performance. Proportionate reduction of honorarium applies for unauthorized absence or absence beyond permissible leave.

content_sections.heading: RSLSA Legal Researcher Job Description
content_sections.text: Without adversely affecting the generality of work, the Legal Researcher performs the following duties under the direct control of the Member Secretary and other officers of RSLSA: To prepare various reports, schemes, and monitor progress of ongoing activities. To analyze, evaluate, and research on various subjects of daily use, preparation of study material for seminars, workshops, conferences, and trainings. To carry out research work on law and legal issues including various judgments of Hon'ble Supreme Court, Hon'ble High Courts, and other forums. To assist in outreach and awareness activities. To assist in drafting agenda, meeting notes, concept notes, and reports on schemes and programmes. To supervise and conduct field surveys and prepare analytical reports with analysis of data. To work with the office of Hon'ble Executive Chairman, RSLSA and provide day-to-day activities as per directions. To do academic, administrative, research, and other work directed by the Rajasthan State Legal Services Authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RSLSA Legal Researcher
content_sections.text: Download the application form and scheme details from the official website https://rajasthan.nalsa.gov.in . Affix a recently taken (not later than six months) colored passport-size photograph with your own signature thereon on the application form. Attach self-attested copies of all documents in support of age, educational qualifications, extracurricular activities, and experience. Furnish a checklist along with the application form detailing the enclosed certificates and testimonials. Submit a signed undertaking on the prescribed proforma stating that during engagement you will not practice in any court of law or engage in any other professional pursuit. Pack the application in an envelope marked clearly with "APPLICATION FOR THE LEGAL RESEARCHER". Send the application via Speed Post, Registered Post, or through Courier, or deposit it by hand during office hours to the Office of Member Secretary, Rajasthan State Legal Services Authority, Jaipur Vidhik Seva Sadan, Rajasthan High Court Campus, C-Scheme, Jaipur - 302005 on or before 31-10-2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinized under the direction of the Member Secretary, RSLSA. The selection is made by a Selection Committee constituted by the Hon'ble Executive Chairman, Rajasthan State Legal Services Authority. Shortlisting of applications may be done based on research achievements, academic career, computer skills, or other criteria. The Selection Committee assesses suitability through screening and/or interviewing candidates, considering research and academic record, language communication, and computer skills.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for RSLSA Legal Researcher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies, with 2 vacancies for Rajasthan State Legal Services Authority, Jodhpur and 1 vacancy for Rajasthan State Legal Services Authority, Jaipur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting filled application forms is 31-10-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a fresh law graduate or post graduate in law from a recognised University, College, or Institution established by law in India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age of the candidate as on 1st January of year 2027 must not be more than 33 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary or honorarium provided?
faq.answer: Selected Legal Researchers receive a fixed honorarium of Rs. 50,000/- per month without any dearness or other allowance or perquisite.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their filled application form along with self-attested documents by Speed Post, Registered Post, Courier, or by hand to the Office of Member Secretary, RSLSA, Jaipur.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is on a purely temporary and contractual basis for a term up to 2 years, with initial engagement made for six months.

faq.question: Q9. Can final semester law students apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates appearing for their final semester may apply, but they must submit their final pass out result before the final process of selection.

faq.question: Q10. Can a Legal Researcher practice in a court of law during their engagement?
faq.answer: No, candidates must submit an undertaking that during engagement as a Legal Researcher they shall neither practice in any court of law nor engage in any other professional pursuit.
